summary: Exact engine restart/resume and hardened MP3 seek: after a restart the engine resumes the interrupted track at its saved position (early-rollover queues and true crossfades handled), and seek/resume exposes audio only once its target is confirmed. No migrations, requirements/packages, systemd, nginx, static or protected-runtime changes. Only the engine restarts; Gunicorn is unchanged. A restart still releases an active manual hold.
